settings.title: Check every (minutes)
settings.help: How often UsageHUD reads both subscriptions. Opening the panel also reads one that is over a minute old.

settings.title: Show Claude
settings.help: Reads Claude Code's sign-in from its credentials file, or from the Keychain through /usr/bin/security, which the item already trusts (no prompt).

settings.title: Show Codex
settings.help: Reads Codex's sign-in from ~/.codex/auth.json, and its session logs when offline.
